title: MCPToolRegistry
description: The Curfew local and remote MCP tool registries. Local tools address the current Mac. Remote tools address account-enrolled devices through the Curfew coordinator.

name.description: Stable identifier sent in `tools/list` and matched in `tools/call`.

description.description: Human-readable description shown to the AI model when it enumerates tools.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the `arguments` payload the tool accepts.

tools.name: curfew.status
tools.description: Returns the current Curfew enforcement status: phase (working, warning, locked, day_off), minutes remaining until lock, today's schedule window, and whether an extension can be requested right now.

tools.name: curfew.schedule
tools.description: Returns the full weekly Curfew schedule: per-day lock and unlock times, which days are marked as day-off, and any pending schedule change that is waiting out a 24-hour anti-bypass cooldown.

tools.name: curfew.budget
tools.description: Returns this week's extension and override budget: weekly limits, how many have been used so far, remaining slots, and duration per slot. Useful for deciding whether to request an extension or escalate to an override.

tools.name: curfew.activity
tools.description: Returns recent activity events from the local log. Pass `{"period": "today"}` to limit to today's events or `{"period": "week"}` (default) for the full current week.

tools.name: curfew.get_time_remaining
tools.description: Returns a compact machine-readable countdown: minutes until lockout, the current curfew mode ("time", "hours", or "combined"), and which trigger is driving the countdown. Useful for small widgets, status bars, and assistants that just need the number.

tools.name: curfew.get_weekly_summary
tools.description: Returns this week's activity rollup: lockouts held, extensions and overrides used, and a current streak count. The device attribution field echoes the local device name today; multi-device aggregation lands when CloudKit device records ship.

tools.name: curfew.request_extension
tools.description: Queues a request for a work-session extension (default +15 min). The Curfew app will show the user a consent prompt; extensions are only granted during warning stages (T-30 and T-15). Returns a request ID you can poll with `curfew.request_status`.

reason.description: Why more time is needed (shown to the user).

tools.name: curfew.request_override
tools.description: Queues a "Convince Me" override request. If approved by the user, Curfew temporarily suspends the lockout for the configured override duration (default 30 min). Requires a justification of at least 50 characters. Returns a request ID to poll with `curfew.request_status`.

tools.name: curfew.set_schedule
tools.description: Queues a schedule change for a single weekday. Weakening changes (later lock time, adding a day off) wait out a 24-hour cooldown; strengthening changes apply at the next day boundary. Requires the user to approve the change in the Curfew app unless the AI consent policy is set to auto-approve.

unlock_time.description: Optional. Defaults to the day's current unlock time.

is_day_off.description: Optional. Set true to mark the day off.

tools.name: curfew.request_status
tools.description: Returns the current approval status for a pending MCP write request. Pass the `request_id` returned by `curfew.request_extension` or `curfew.request_override`. Status is one of: pending, approved, denied.

request_id.description: UUID returned by the write tool.

remoteTools.name: curfew_get_status
remoteTools.description: Returns normalized Curfew status for the requested eligible device, or all enrolled devices when no device ID is supplied.

remoteTools.name: curfew_list_devices
remoteTools.description: Lists enrolled devices, their current status freshness, and whether each device is locally eligible for remote locking and lock-all.

remoteTools.name: curfew_lock_device
remoteTools.description: Locks one locally eligible device for a bounded duration or until its next scheduled unlock. This cannot unlock or weaken Curfew.

remoteTools.name: curfew_lock_devices
remoteTools.description: Locks an explicit set of locally eligible devices and returns a separate result for every target.

remoteTools.name: curfew_lock_all_devices
remoteTools.description: Locks every enrolled device that was locally opted into lock-all, returning a separate result for every target.

remoteTools.name: curfew_get_command_status
remoteTools.description: Returns queued, delivered, applied, rejected, or expired results for a previously submitted remote lock command.

remoteTools.name: curfew_open_control_panel
remoteTools.description: Opens the Curfew MCP App control panel with current device status and target-selection switches.
